question.text: Based on Xia Qingchuan's behavior of ordering dessert late at night in Session 6 and her inner feelings, as well as the "nourishing" dietary ritual she designed in Session 7, analyze how she transformed emotional eating into a positive act of self-care.

questions.original_answer: In Session 6, Xia Qingchuan orders dessert late at night, accompanied by a sense of guilt. She realizes this is "emotional hunger" rather than physical hunger, stemming from a feeling of emptiness or anxiety after organizing her "emotional aesthetics" photo album. In Session 7, she transforms this awareness into an active "nourishing" dietary ritual, such as preparing visually pleasing stress-relief tea snacks (like red flower tea) or fruit platters by hand. She focuses on the visual aesthetics during the preparation process (color contrasts resembling a "miniature sunset") and sensory experiences (the steam from hot tea). By channeling perfectionism into creation rather than consumption, and replacing automatic emotional eating with "preparation" and "experience," she successfully shifts anxiety-driven behavior into self-care-driven actions, establishing new healthy connections.
questions.validation_notes: Examine the process of knowledge updating and transformation from problematic behaviors (emotional eating) to solutions (nourishing rituals).

question.text: In Session 1, Su Mingche suggested that Xia Qingchuan track emotional fluctuations to anticipate the lows following periods of high energy. In Session 14, how was this suggestion upgraded to become part of a more systematic "energy dashboard"? What specifically do the "warning signals" refer to?

questions.original_answer: In Session 1, Su Mingche suggested that Xia Qingchuan record simple emotional and physical signals (such as "excitement, tense shoulders") to warn of exhaustion after periods of high energy. By Session 14, this suggestion was upgraded to become part of an "energy dashboard" system. This system specifically defines "warning signals" as follows: when an activity corresponding to a core value is neglected for three consecutive days (for example, neglecting "creative expression" for three days in a row), the system prompts the user to engage in corresponding Alerting activities (fuel) to boost energy or adjust their state. This evolution transforms the approach from simple passive recording into an active, dynamic health maintenance mechanism based on personal values.
questions.validation_notes: Track how a core suggestion (mood logging) is systematically developed and upgraded into more complex tools (energy dashboard and warning signals) throughout the conversation journey.
